anchors.statement: When [tool.sc-lint].runner.python names a repository venv directory, a leading "python" in the argv of any sc-lint lint or test step must run that venv's interpreter (bin/python, or Scripts\python.exe on Windows) on Linux, macOS and Windows.
anchors.quote: Semantics we need from `runner.python`: (1) a leading `"python"` in any lint **or test** step argv resolves to that venv's interpreter on every OS; (2) the venv's bin/Scripts dir is prepended to the child's PATH (our `python_cmd` does this today so helpers that spawn `python` stay pinned); (3) it must apply to `test` steps, not only `lint` ones.
anchors.context: Phase M v2 re-derivation from REQ/ADR and issue text, 2026-10-30; candidate C08
anchors.scope: The item changes how sc-lint resolves the interpreter for lint or test step argv.

pass: With runner.python set to .venv, a leading python in a lint step and in a test step runs .venv/bin/python on Unix and .venv\Scripts\python.exe on Windows. Evidence: test runner_python_argv passes for a lint step and a test step on Linux, macOS and Windows.
fail: runner.python rewrites a leading python only in lint steps; test steps still run whatever python is on PATH.

anchors.statement: When [tool.sc-lint].runner.python names a repository venv directory, sc-lint must prepend that venv's bin directory (Scripts on Windows) to the PATH of every lint and test step's child process.
anchors.quote: Semantics we need from `runner.python`: (1) a leading `"python"` in any lint **or test** step argv resolves to that venv's interpreter on every OS; (2) the venv's bin/Scripts dir is prepended to the child's PATH (our `python_cmd` does this today so helpers that spawn `python` stay pinned); (3) it must apply to `test` steps, not only `lint` ones.
anchors.context: Phase M v2 re-derivation from REQ/ADR and issue text, 2026-10-30; candidate C09
anchors.scope: The item changes the environment sc-lint passes to lint or test step child processes.

pass: With runner.python set, sc-lint prepends the venv's bin directory (Scripts on Windows) to every step's PATH. Evidence: test runner_python_prepends_path passes, showing PATH starts with the venv directory for a lint step and a test step.
fail: runner.python rewrites only the leading python argv, so a helper that spawns python picks up the interpreter on PATH.

anchors.statement: sc-lint must provide a step form, such as a module step kind or a documented sc-lint lint subcommand, that runs a named sc_lint.* wheel helper module on the sc-lint kit's interpreter on every OS without a consumer-written per-OS interpreter path.
anchors.quote: The wheel-only helpers (`sc_lint.lint_cargo_deny`, `lint_cargo_shear`, `lint_manifests`, `lint_codespell`) have to be invoked as `.sc-lint/venv/bin/python -m ...` on every OS (`Scripts\python.exe` on Windows). There is no step form that says "run this module on the kit's interpreter", so we carry a 3-line `_sc-lint-py` recipe with a per-OS interpreter path. A step kind like `{"module": "sc_lint.lint_cargo_deny"}` or a documented `sc-lint lint deny|shear|manifests|spell` subcommand would delete it.
anchors.context: Phase M v2 re-derivation from REQ/ADR and issue text, 2026-10-30; candidate C12
anchors.scope: The item changes how a consumer step invokes an sc_lint.* wheel helper module.

pass: Adds a module step kind that runs sc_lint.lint_cargo_deny on the sc-lint kit interpreter on every OS. Evidence: test module_step_uses_kit_interpreter passes, showing the step used the kit venv interpreter on Linux, macOS and Windows with no per-OS path in the config.
fail: Consumers must still write .sc-lint/venv/bin/python and Scripts\python.exe per OS to run sc_lint.* helpers.
